text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed it is~~!! The very first race along 
the Classic Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Do not get overwhelmed by the race's 
prestige, and run through without tensing 
up. Isn't that right?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Leave it to me! I can do anything 
if I put my mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's give them a nice 
rubdown—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the doorknob has broken off~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, but I only spun it a tiny, tiny 
bit, you know~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She's pushing herself far too hard as 
usual. But unlike last year, with how she 
is now, even if she runs in a GⅠ—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawawa, what should we do? Glue? Or 
superglue?
